findings.label: Ended cleanly

examples.note: The call did not end with a clear next step or clean goodbye; the agent prompted the lead to continue after the lead had already declined.
examples.evidence: No worries. Go ahead. What were you going to say?

examples.note: The user hung up mid-conversation, so the call did not end cleanly.
The call ended abruptly by the customer, with the agent continuing to pitch after the lead indicated to discuss in the meeting, not now.
examples.evidence: No. This that we will discuss in the meeting. Not now.

examples.note: The call ended with the customer hanging up and no clear next step or clean goodbye.
examples.evidence: Call ended abruptly by customer. No clear next step established.

findings.guidance: Did the call finish on a clear next step or a clean goodbye? FAIL if she re-pitched after a no, repeated herself, trailed off, or the lead hung up on her mid-sentence. N/A only if the call never connected to a person.

findings.label: Handled the objection

examples.note: The lead objected ('Honestly, I have already got 1.') and Sarah accepted it and closed without a second ask.
examples.evidence: Got it. Okay. So you've already got something

examples.note: The lead raised a timing objection, but Sarah did not acknowledge it or make a second ask; she allowed the call to end after the objection.
examples.evidence: It's not a good time to call right now. Thank you. Another time.

examples.note: The lead indicated they were not the intended recipient (wrong number), which is a form of objection. Sarah did not acknowledge or clarify, but ended the call immediately.
examples.evidence: I am not, uh, besides my bra my brother Other number. This is my number.

examples.note: The lead raised an objection ('not interested anymore'), but Sarah did not acknowledge it or make a second ask; she stopped after 'All'.
examples.evidence: Actually, no. I'm not interested anymore. Thank you.

findings.guidance: ONLY when the lead actually raised one: price, timing, "send me an email", "not interested", "already have someone". PASS if she acknowledged it and made a second ask rather than folding on the first no. FAIL if she accepted it and closed. **N/A if the lead raised no objection** — most calls, and scoring those as failures would make the tile measure how many leads objected.

findings.label: Opener said correctly

examples.note: Sarah did not identify herself or ConvoFlow or reference the reason for the call before pitching. She only did so after being asked.
examples.evidence: AI: Cool. Thanks. So before I get into what's changed, when you inquired, what was actually going on on your end?

examples.note: She did not identify herself or ConvoFlow, nor reference why she was calling before pitching.
examples.evidence: so before I get into what's changed back when you inquired, what was actually going on on your end?

examples.note: She did not identify herself or ConvoFlow, nor reference why she was calling before pitching.
examples.evidence: So before I get into what's changed, back when you inquired what was actually going on on your end that got you thinking about a system like this?

examples.note: She did not identify herself or ConvoFlow or get permission before pitching; she launched into a question about the lead's situation.
examples.evidence: So before I get into what's changed, back when you inquired what was actually going on on your end, that got you thinking about a system like this?

findings.guidance: Did she identify herself and ConvoFlow, reference why she is calling, and get permission to continue, all before pitching? PASS if the lead knew who was calling and why within the first two turns. FAIL if she launched in, or never said where she was calling from. N/A only if the lead never spoke at all.

findings.label: Booking rules followed

examples.note: A time was discussed, but Sarah did not ask for a commitment (e.g., 'can I count on you being there?').
examples.evidence: I'll call you back Thursday afternoon. Speak then.

findings.guidance: ONLY when a time was discussed. PASS if the slot she offered was a real one, it was far enough out to be kept, and she asked for the commitment - "can I count on you being there?". FAIL if she invented a time, offered something within the hour, or booked without asking for a commitment. **N/A if no time was ever discussed.**
